response.justification: Bogdan has extensive fullstack experience with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL-adjacent technologies, plus strong architectural and open-source contributions, but his title of 'Senior' and 10+ years of experience significantly exceed the junior/mid-level scope, and his German language barrier and high on-site requirement pose practical risks for this role.
strengths: Deep TypeScript and React experience across multiple production systems
Proven fullstack ownership from API to UI with clean architecture focus
Strong open-source contributions and dev-ops skills (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD)
concerns: Overqualified for junior/mid-level role; risk of low retention or misalignment
German language proficiency is only basic, but role requires high on-site presence
Extensive use of DLang and niche tools may indicate misalignment with stack priorities
